Directions: Questions 19 - 25 deal with logical and analytical reasons. Read the given set of conditions and assumption for each question. Choose the answe at you think is most appropriations among the given alternatives. 

19) Tamrat’s train never bothered him because there were always seats available on it, and he was able to spend his time on the train comfortably reading the newspaper or playing games on his mobile phone. Ever since the train schedule changed, train has been extremely crowded, and by the time the doors open at his station, there is not a seat to be found.
options: A Any traveller who uses the train will complain about the new schedule
B Tamrat will likely look for anew job closer to home.
C Tamrat would be better off taking the bus to work instead of the train
D Tamrat’s train is less comfortable since the train schedule changed
explanation:
The passage explains that the train used to be comfortable with available seats, but after the schedule changed, it became extremely crowded.

 This directly implies that the train is now less comfortable, making option D the most appropriate choice.

question: It is called Restitution when you compensate someone for damaging his or her property in some way, which of the following situations is the best example of Restitution?
options: A Peter asks Tom to stay in his apartment when he is out of town. One day Tom arrives to A stay and finds that pipe has burst and the apartment is filled with water. He calls the plumber to repair the pipe and pays for the repair
B A pothole in the parking of Peter's company caused his flat tyre. He informs his boss and expects that the company should pay for the repair.
C Tom borrows his friend’s car and returns the car with an empty petrol tank. He apologizes and tells his friend that he will fill the tank tomorrow.

D Tom borrows his friend’s camera. Tom fails to zipper the case, and the camera falls on the ground, and the lens shatters. When Tom returns the camera, he tells his friend that he will pay for the damage.
explanation:
Restitution involves compensating someone for damage caused to their property. 

Option D clearly describes a situation where Tom caused damage to the camera and agrees to pay for it, making it the best example of restitution.

question: A four - person crew is painting Mr. Odom's house. Michael is painting the front of the house. Roza is in the alley behind the house painting the back. Jemal is painting the window frames on the north side. Shawul is on the south. If Michael switches places with Jamal, and Jemal then switches places with Shawul, where is Shawul?
options: A in front of the house
B on the south side of the house
C in the alley behind the house
D on the north side of the house
explanation: After the switches, Shawul ends up in Michael's original position at the front of the house.

question: Four friends in the sixth grade were sharing a pizza. They decided that the oldest friend would get the extra piece. Haawi is two months older than Geremew, who is three months younger than Nardos. Kemal is one month older than Geremew. Who should get the extra piece of pizza?
options: A Nardos
B Geremew
C Kemal
D Hawi
explanation: Nardos is the oldest among the four friends, so according to the agreement, she should get the extra piece of pizza.

question:
If you are a fitness walker, you don't need to go to a health gym. you also don't need any fitness equipment for workouts. All you need is a pair of comfortable athletic shoes.

 Which of the following statements does this paragraph suggest?
options: A Fitness walking is an effective and convenient form of exercise
B poorly designed shoes can cause foot injuries
C Fitness walking is better than weight lifting
D Walking outdoors provides more health benefits than walking indoors.
explanation:
The paragraph emphasizes that fitness walking requires no gym or equipment, only comfortable shoes.

 This suggests that it is a convenient and accessible form of exercise, making option A correct.

question:
Sara lives in Adama. Her younger cousin Martha lives in a small town in the eastern part of Ethiopia Martha has visited Sara several times during the past five Years. In the same period of time, Sara has visited Martha only once

Which of the following statements is a reasonable assumption or inference?
options: A Sara is older than Martha
B Martha wants to move to another town
C Martha likes Sara better than Sara likes Martha.
D Sara thinks small towns are boring.
explanation:
Given that Martha has visited Sara multiple times while Sara has visited Martha only once, a reasonable inference is that Sara, being older, may have more responsibilities or less flexibility to travel.

 Therefore, option A is the most logical assumption.

question: Solomon introduced Sara as the mother of his sister's brother. How is Sara related to Solomon?
options: A Mother
B Sister
C Aunt
D Nicce
explanation:
Solomon’s sister’s brother is Solomon himself, and Sara is the mother of that brother.

 Therefore, Sara is Solomon’s mother.

question:
Mrs. Genet wishes to renovate her cottage. She hires the services of a plumber, a carpenter, a painter, an electrician, and an interior decorator. The renovation is to be completed in a period of one week, i.e., Monday to Friday. Every worker will be taking one complete day to do his job. Mrs.Genet will allow just one person to work per day.

- The painter can do this work only after the plumber and the carpenter have completed their jobs.

The interior decorator has to complete his job before that of the electrician.

The carpenter cannot works on Monday or Tuesday. 

In case the painter wor ks on Thursday, which among the following alternative is possible?
options: A The interior decorator does his work after the painter
B The plumber and the painter work on consecutive days.
C The electrician works on Tuesday
D The electrician works on Friday.
explanation:
Given the constraints and that the painter works on Thursday, the electrician must work after the interior decorator and painter.

 Friday is the only available day that satisfies all conditions.
